Download artifacts from a repository

Download an artifact from a Repsy repository: rp download &lt;format&gt; &lt;name&gt; --repo &lt;name&gt;.

Files come from the repository host (the protocol host of the profile), not
from the panel API. A public repository is read anonymously. A private one
answers 401 with a WWW-Authenticate challenge, and rp then answers with the
credential it uses everywhere (REPSY_TOKEN, else the stored credential of the
profile) as HTTP Basic or Bearer, whichever the server asks for; a deploy token
or a personal access token works, a login session does not.

The file is streamed into a temporary file next to the destination, checked
against the digest the format publishes, and only then renamed into place, so
the destination never holds a partial file, also after Ctrl-C. A file whose
format publishes no digest is stored but reported as not verified.

Downloads cannot be resumed: the server supports no Range requests and never
redirects to storage, so a download that breaks starts again from the first
byte (rp retries a few times by itself) and there is no --continue. For a very
large file, such as a Docker layer, a broken connection costs the whole file.

```
rp download
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --api-url string           Panel API URL of the profile, overrides the stored value
      --ca-file string           PEM file with extra trusted CA certificates
      --debug                    Print debug output with secrets redacted
      --hostname string          Repsy host to use instead of the current profile
      --insecure                 Do not verify TLS certificates (unsafe; plain http is chosen with the URL, not with this flag)
      --insecure-storage         Keep credentials in a plain 0600 file instead of the OS keyring (unsafe; a warning is printed once per command)
      --jq string                Filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --output json)
      --no-color                 Disable colored output
      --no-input                 Never prompt; fail when input is needed
      --output table|json|yaml   Output format: table, json or yaml (default table; json when --jq is given)
      --owner string             Owner segment of Cloud protocol URLs; --owner= means none
      --registry-url string      Protocol host URL of the profile, overrides the stored value
      --type os|cloud            Product of the host, overrides detection
      --web-url string           Panel UI URL of the profile (where /cli/auth lives), overrides the stored value
      --yes                      Answer yes to confirmation prompts
```
